surface.$description: Raised surface: cards, packets, filled fields.

bg-recessed.$description: Recessed wells. Text here takes deep or ink, never gold-ink.

hues.source: Mina §1.6 register; Iris §2.1; Ada ruling 1 ground restriction

surface-player.$description: Player surface only. No other component may take it.

text-strong.$description: Headings and strong text (11.38:1 on paper-1).

text-faint.$description: Faint text (6.24:1). Every text use of sage points here.

accent.$description: Graphics, rules, stitch only. Never text.

hues.source: Mina §1.6 register (was color.accent.gold); Iris §2.2; Ada ruling 1

accent-strong.$description: Large text, graphics, and light-ground focus-ring duty only. No normal-text roles.

accent-ink.$description: Text-weight gold. Ground restriction: not on paper-2.

hues.source: Mina §1.6 register text gold; Ada ruling 1 PASS with ground restriction

link.$description: Link color. Links inside body prose carry a standing underline (gold-ink vs ink is 2.03:1).

hues.source: Mina §1.6 register; Iris §2.2; Ada ruling 1 rider + closing C

focus-ring-light.$description: Focus ring on light grounds, with the deep offset.

hues.source: Mina §1.6 register --color-focus; Ada ruling 5 ground-following fix

focus-offset-light.$description: Focus offset on light grounds, with the gold-3 ring.

hues.source: Mina §1.6 register --color-focus; Ada ruling 5 ground-following fix

focus-ring-deep.$description: Focus ring on deep grounds (deep, deep-2, frame), with the paper-1 offset.

hues.source: Mina §1.6 register --color-focus; Ada ruling 5 ground-following fix

focus-offset-deep.$description: Focus offset on deep grounds, with the gold-2 ring.

hues.source: Mina §1.6 register --color-focus; Ada ruling 5 ground-following fix

on-accent.$description: Text on gold-3 and deep fills.

on-deep-soft.$description: Soft accent text on deep fills.

accent-leaf.$description: Checkbox and radio accent and the success state only.

hues.source: Mina §1.6 register; Iris plugs §A.2; Ada ruling 6a

destructive.$description: Destructive actions and confirmations only; always labeled, never icon-only.

hues.source: Mina §1.6 register + §3.1; Iris plugs §A.3; Ada ruling 6b

line.$description: Decorative hairlines only (1.43:1). Never an interactive boundary.

line-strong.$description: Interactive line on permitted grounds only (paper-0, white, paper-player, seeds warmed, gold-0); ink-soft takes paper-1, paper-2, sage-0.

hues.source: Mina §1.6 register; Iris plugs §C; Ada ruling 3 PASS as amended

border-field.$description: Field-kit border stack-wide (3.43-4.20:1 on every ground).

hues.source: Mina §1.6 register (was color.border.field); Iris plugs §A.1; Ada ruling 4

state-success.$description: Success and open state text on the sage-0 tint (5.61:1).

state-warning.$description: Warning and held state text on the gold-0 tint (6.13:1).

state-error.$description: Error and closed state text on the clay tint (5.09:1).

state-info.$description: Info and note state text on the slate tint (4.61:1, least headroom).

selection.$description: Text selection wash: house gold at 35 percent.

accent-seasonal.$description: Reserved seasonal accent slot. Park default; gift-cards values arrive in a later Iris and Elena pass.
